scope: Public advertiser cards only. Publicidad excluded explicitly; no changes to its loading/rendering.

code_findings.finding: One shared guide promise per opening, compact=1 response already active; search/filter/page operate on downloaded rows
code_findings.recommendation: Preserve current behavior; no additional Worker change justified by this sample

code_findings.finding: fetchInstagramImage calls external proxy for each gallery render, without result/pending dedup cache; renderGaleria schedules this on every render
code_findings.recommendation: Reuse successful URL lookups and pending lookups within current page. Preserve explicit retry for failures.
code_findings.limit: Code-confirmed opportunity; actual repeated external request count and byte savings not measured.

code_findings.finding: Card/gallery img markup lacks loading=lazy; images in horizontal galleries/downscreen cards can be fetched before viewed
code_findings.recommendation: Defer below-view gallery images; preserve visible/critical images and modal loading.
code_findings.limit: Savings relate to external image transfer, not a measured reduction of Firestore/KV/SQL.
